# coolify_hostinger_catalog (Data Source)

Lists Hostinger KVM VPS plans Coolify can purchase. Prices are integer cents. Requires Coolify >= v4.5.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_hostinger_catalog" "all" {
  cloud_provider_token_uuid = coolify_cloud_token.hostinger.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider_token_uuid` (String) UUID of a Hostinger cloud provider token used to list catalog items.

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter results by field values. Multiple filters are ANDed together. Multiple values within a filter are ORed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Catalog items whose id matches a KVM VPS plan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by.
- `values` (Set of String) The values to match against. Multiple values are ORed.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Hostinger category. Coolify requests VPS.
- `id` (String) Catalog item id. Pass this to `coolify_server_hostinger.item_id`.
- `name` (String) Plan name.
- `prices` (Attributes List) Billing prices. `price` and `first_period_price` are cents. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--prices))

<a id="nestedatt--items--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.prices`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) Currency code.
- `first_period_price` (Number) First period price in cents.
- `id` (String) Price id.
- `name` (String) Price name.
- `period` (Number) Billing period length.
- `period_unit` (String) Period unit, such as month.
- `price` (Number) Recurring price in cents.
